enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Fall asleep. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Turn to right side. Bend knees. Pull blanket. Sleep. Turn on back. Stretch arms. Sleep. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, showering and washing up
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on shower. Apply soap. Wash body. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Walk to sink. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face with towel. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast with toast and tea
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out bread, butter, jam, milk. Close refrigerator. Plug in toaster. Insert bread slices. Press lever down. Take out plate, knife, mug, tea bag from cupboard. Fill kettle with water. Plug in kettle. Turn on kettle. Spread butter on toast. Spread jam on toast. Place tea bag in mug. Pour hot water into mug. Add milk to tea. Stir tea. Sit at table. Eat toast. Drink tea.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing work items for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt, trousers, underwear, socks. Close wardrobe. Remove pajamas. Put on underwear. Put on shirt. Put on trousers. Put on socks. Pick up watch. Put on watch. Pick up phone. Check phone. Pick up bag. Open bag. Place stethoscope in bag. Place ID badge in bag. Place wallet in bag. Close bag. Walk out of bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for the work shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Put phone in pocket. Stand up. Pull cord. Exit bus. Walk to hospital entrance. Push door open. Walk to locker room. Open locker. Change into scrubs. Put street clothes in locker. Close locker. Walk to ward.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, caring for patients and completing clinical duties
enriched_activities.desc: Check patient charts. Enter patient room. Greet patient: 'Good morning, how are you feeling?' Take vital signs. Administer medication. Adjust IV drip. Document in EHR. Communicate with doctor. Assist with procedure. Sterilize equipment. Respond to call button. Walk to patient room. Check patient status. Update family. Attend meeting. Eat lunch. Wash hands. Consult with colleague. Review lab results. Write prescriptions.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Listen to music. Put phone in pocket. Stand up. Pull cord. Exit bus. Walk home. Open front door. Enter house. Close door. Take off shoes. Hang coat.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables, meat. Close refrigerator. Place on counter. Take out pan. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Cut vegetables. Add vegetables to pan. Stir. Add meat. Stir. Add spices. Turn off stove. Serve food. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Cleaning up the kitchen and loading the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up dishes. Scrape food into trash. Rinse dishes. Open dishwasher. Load dishes into dishwasher. Add detergent. Close dishwasher. Turn on dishwasher. Wipe counter with cloth. Wipe stove. Sweep floor. Take out trash. Replace trash bag. Wash hands. Dry hands.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking an evening shower and washing up
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on shower. Apply soap. Wash body. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Walk to sink. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face with towel. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Turn on TV. Pick up remote. Sit on sofa. Change channels. Adjust volume. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on sofa. Eat snack. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading and browsing on the computer using the desk lamp
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on desk lamp. Pick up book. Open book. Read. Turn page. Put book down. Pick up laptop. Open laptop. Turn on laptop. Browse internet. Type on keyboard. Click mouse. Close laptop. Turn off desk lamp. Pick up phone. Check phone. Put phone down. Turn off light. Lie in bed.

enriched_activities.activity: Night routine, brushing teeth and washing face
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Put toothbrush down. Wash face with cleanser. Rinse face. Dry face with towel. Turn off tap.
Lie in bed. Pull blanket. Close eyes. Fall asleep. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Sleep. Turn over. Stretch arm. Pull blanket. Continue sleeping.
